name: Maina
source:
A novelist. Meets Renmaru in the world where time has stopped.

[spoiler]Maina is the original Ego of "Maina Narumi," who was separated from her body and remained stranded in World R at a young age. Her remaining Sublime developed her own Ego, and was adopted and renamed into "Mishima Narumi."

Maina is the older sister of Takae Myuu and Kiridera Mei. She is also the true leader of the Shimura Club, where she poses as the man named Shinkuro.[/spoiler]
